neighbours.label: elementary math curriculum text: standards and lessons on numbers, fractions, decimals and place value
fire: Students will compare fractions with different denominators using benchmark fractions.
Standard 3.NF.2: Understand a fraction as a number on the number line.
In this unit, learners convert improper fractions to mixed numbers.
Place Value: write a three-digit number in expanded form.
Grade 4 Operations and Algebraic Thinking - Use the four operations to solve word problems.
The lesson teaches children to round decimals to the nearest tenth.
Objective: add and subtract mixed numbers with like denominators.
Students learn how to express a ratio as a percent and as a decimal.
quiet: Students will compare poems with different themes using graphic organizers.
Standard 3.RL.2: Recount stories, including fables and folktales from diverse cultures.
In this unit, learners turn rough notes into finished paragraphs.
Map Skills: label the seven continents on a blank world map.
Grade 4 Life Science - Use observations to describe how plants grow.
The lesson teaches children to spell words with silent letters.
Objective: identify the main idea and supporting details of a passage.
Students learn how to express an opinion in a persuasive letter.

notes: Card: top examples are curriculum-standard text (Expand Number, Number and Operations—Fractions, improper fractions to mixed fractions) peaking on function words. + pole is 'by' in 'multiply by' and promotes multiply tokens. Near misses are curriculum text in other subjects.
